name: Financial Analyst
responsibilities: Build valuation and financial models for companies or investment programs, then defend the assumptions behind every number
Analyze a company's financial or operational performance to spot trouble early and recommend a fix, not just a diagnosis
Package findings into client-ready presentations and recommendations on capitalization, financing, or deal structure
skills: Reading financial statements fast enough to know which line moved a valuation and why
Building and stress-testing models in spreadsheet and financial analysis software instead of trusting a single scenario
Framing a recommendation on capital raising, refinancing, or debt restructuring in terms a non-finance client will act on
Pulling data from business intelligence and database tools to back an argument, not just an opinion
rawSkillPool: Business intelligence and data analysis software
Analyzing company financial and operational performance
Advising on capitalization, sources, and timing of financing

evidence.quote: Conduct quantitative analyses of information involving investment programs or financial data of public or private institutions, including valuation of businesses.

Analyze financial or operational performance of companies facing financial difficulties to identify or recommend remedies. Advise clients on aspects of capitalization, such as amounts, sources, or timing.
